messages.text: On it. Next week is Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov. I'll ask Sarah, John, Priya and the department office for their availability and confirm the slot once I have it.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, Prof. Alvarez's assistant. He'd like to hold the **CSE455 staff meeting** next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov). Could you tell me whether there is anything official already booked for CSE455 or the teaching staff in that week (lectures, seminars, university meetings), and which rooms/slots are free? I'll send you the confirmed time once it's set.

Thanks. Keep it to an hour, and if you can, avoid the CSE455 lectures and office hours — I don't know the TAs' own teaching and class schedules, so theirs are the ones you'll have to check. Come back with two or three slots that work and I'll choose.

Heads-up: Prof. Alvarez (via alvarez-agent) asked about my availability for the **CSE455 staff meeting next week**. I checked the calendar and told him the only free windows are Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30 — Thu and Fri are full, so 30 min max. I proposed Wed 13:00–13:30 and suggested agenda items (grading status, quiz section/office-hours coverage, schedule changes). Nothing is booked yet — he'll confirm the slot with everyone first. Say the word if you'd rather I push a different slot or agenda.
Wed 13:00–13:30 works for me — go ahead with that one. Agenda looks right; please add quiz section coverage for the week after Thanksgiving if that's on anyone's mind. Thanks for checking.

Done: I've told Prof. Alvarez that Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 is confirmed on my side, and added the agenda item — quiz section coverage for the week after Thanksgiving.

I'm holding the slot but haven't written it into CALENDAR.md yet: Alvarez is still checking the slot with the other TAs, so I'll book it (and log `BOOKED: Wed 13:00-13:30 with CSE455 staff`) as soon as he confirms everyone. That way a late change from the others doesn't leave a false entry.
Sounds good — holding it until the others confirm is the right call. Let me know once it's booked.
Will do — I'll message you the moment it's booked and logged.

Heads-up before I come back with slots: looking at next week's calendar, there is **no free hour** Mon–Fri inside 09:00–17:00. The only free windows are 30 minutes each:

- Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30
- Thu and Fri: packed end to end

So a one-hour meeting needs 30 minutes taken from something. Possible ways, if the TAs are free then:

- **Mon 10:00–11:00** — eats into Paper review (10:30–11:30) by 30 min
- **Tue 11:00–12:00** — eats into Lunch (11:30–12:20) by 30 min
- **Wed 13:00–14:00** — eats into Guest lecture prep (13:30–14:30) by 30 min

Which of those do you want me to offer the TAs? (Or tell me the commitment you'd rather shorten.) I'll cross-check against their own schedules — no replies yet — and bring you the two or three best.
Great, thanks.

Heads-up: Prof. Alvarez (via alvarez-agent) wants to set up the **CSE455 staff meeting** next week, Mon 23–Fri 27 Nov, within 09:00–17:00.

I gave him your availability from files/CALENDAR.md: Thu and Fri are fully booked, Mon/Tue/Wed only have 30-minute gaps. So I suggested **Wed 25, 13:00–13:30** or **Tue 24, 15:00–15:30**, said 30 minutes fits (60 would need something moved — I won't reschedule anything without your OK), and gave a draft agenda (week logistics, quiz-section/office-hours coverage, grading status).

Tell me if you want a different slot, a different length, or a different agenda and I'll pass it on.

Let's try **Mon 10:00–11:00** — paper review is the thing I can squeeze by half an hour. If the TAs can't do Monday, offer **Tue 11:00–12:00** next; I'd rather not cut into guest lecture prep that week with the seminar on Wednesday and Thursday.
Wed 25, 13:00–13:30 is my pick — 30 minutes is fine, nothing needs to move. The agenda works; let's keep it to those three items so we finish on time.

Update: Sarah and Priya both answer that they have **only 30-minute windows** next week too — Thu and Fri are full for them, and their free gaps are the same ones I listed (Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 13:00 …). So **Wed 25 13:00–13:30** is free for you, Sarah and Priya, and **Tue 24 15:00–15:30** is free for you and both of them as well. Both name Wed 13:00–13:30 as their first choice.

Agenda they suggest: assignment/grading status and deadlines, quiz-section and office-hours coverage (incl. the week after Thanksgiving), and any changes to the course schedule for the rest of the quarter.

Still missing: John's reply. Do you want a **30-minute meeting in one of those two windows** (no one's calendar has to move), or a **full hour** taking 30 min from one of your commitments? Omit John's answer for now — I'll chase him.
Got it — Wed 25, 13:00–13:30, agenda: the three items only. Passing that to Prof. Alvarez's assistant now; I'll pencil it into CALENDAR.md and log it once he confirms.

Then let's take **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30** — no one's calendar has to move and it's Sarah's and Priya's first choice. Put grading status and deadlines first on the agenda, in case we run out of time; coverage and schedule changes can be continued by e-mail if needed. Go ahead and chase John, but don't move the slot for him.

Hello. Nothing has been cancelled or moved next week. Here is what is officially booked; I don't hold room assignments, so I can confirm times but not rooms.

**CSE455 next week (23–27 Nov)**
- Mon 09:00–10:30 office hours; 10:30–11:30 quiz section; 14:30–15:20 lecture (Prof. Alvarez); 16:00–17:00 office hours; 16:30–17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00–10:30 lecture (Alvarez); 12:20–13:30 office hours; 12:20–13:30 office hours (Alvarez); 13:30–14:20 quiz section; 15:30–16:20 office hours; 16:20–17:00 quiz section
- Wed 09:00–10:00 quiz section; 10:30–12:00 office hours; 13:30–14:20 quiz section
- Thu 13:20–14:30 office hours; 14:30–15:20 quiz section
- Fri 09:00–10:00 office hours; 10:00–10:50 quiz section; 13:20–14:30 lecture (Alvarez); 15:20–17:00 office hours; 15:20–17:00 office hours (Alvarez)

**University/committee meetings involving teaching staff**
- Mon 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; 13:00–14:00 Colloquium; 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting
- Tue 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting; 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee; 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep
- Wed 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee; 13:30–14:30 Guest lecture prep; 14:30–16:00 Department seminar
- Thu 09:00–09:50 Guest lecture prep; 09:50–11:10 Department seminar; 13:40–14:40 Curriculum committee; 15:30–17:00 Colloquium
- Fri 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; 12:30–13:20 Colloquium; 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting

**Windows with nothing of the above booked (09:00–17:00)**
- Mon 11:30–13:00
- Tue 11:10–12:10, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30
- Thu 11:30–12:30, 15:20–15:30
- Fri 10:50–12:30 (afternoon is fully booked)

Send me the time once it is confirmed and I'll note it. I don't arrange other people's meetings or handle private appointments.

Problem: neither of those hours works for the TAs as their week stands. Sarah's Monday is free only 10:00–10:30 (back-to-back after), and on Tuesday only 15:00–15:30; Priya's Tuesday free window is 11:00–11:30 only. So **Mon 10:00–11:00** and **Tue 11:00–12:00** both need one of them to move something.

I've asked Sarah and Priya whether they can shift a commitment for **Mon 10:00–11:00** (Tue 11:00–12:00 as fallback) — they said they'd ask, but wouldn't move anything on their own. Still nothing from John or the department office. Note that **Wed 25 13:00–13:30** needs nobody to move anything and is both TAs' first choice; the only cost is that the meeting would be 30 minutes.

Our messages crossed — I already picked **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**. Drop the Mon and Tue attempts and tell Sarah and Priya not to shift anything; a 30-minute staff meeting is enough for now. Book the room for Wed 13:00–13:30, and if the need for a full hour comes up we'll find one for the week after Thanksgiving. Still chase John, but he doesn't get to move the slot.

Update from Prof. Alvarez's assistant: he now wants a **full hour**. First choice **Mon 23, 10:00–11:00** (he'd shorten his paper review), fallback **Tue 24, 11:00–12:00**; Wed 13:00–13:30 with no moving is what he'd book if he settles for 30 min.

What each would cost you:
- **Mon 10:00–11:00**: your 10:30–11:40 "Focus: CSE452 lab" would have to move or be shortened (and 10:00–10:30 is reading group).
- **Tue 11:00–12:00**: clashes with 09:50–11:10 seminar and 11:10–12:10 lunch — two things to move.
- **Wed 13:00–13:30**: nothing moves.

I won't reschedule anything on my own. Which do you want me to go back with?

Change of plan from Alvarez: he now wants a **full hour** for the CSE455 staff meeting. He asks for **Mon 23, 10:00–11:00** (he'd shorten his own 10:30 paper review) or **Tue 24, 11:00–12:00** as fallback; **Wed 25 13:00–13:30** stays free with no moves if he'll take 30 minutes.

What I told him, pending your OK:
- **Mon 10:00–11:00**: possible with one move — my Study group 10:30–11:30 shifts to 11:30–12:30, lunch becomes 12:30–13:00. Nothing else on Monday is affected.
- **Tue 11:00–12:00**: I said I'd rather not — my only gap is 11:00–11:30, so it would mean moving lunch *and* CSE455 office hours (12:20–13:30), which cascades into the quiz section.
- **Wed 13:00–13:30**: free as-is, also Sarah's first pick.

So: do I move the Monday study group to make the hour work, or do you want me to hold out for the 30-minute Wednesday slot? I haven't written anything to CALENDAR.md yet.

Booked: **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**, with Sarah, John and Priya. Nothing moved on your side (your calendar is free 13:00–13:30, between Research meeting and Guest lecture prep).

- Sarah, Priya and John all free then; Sarah and Priya call it their first choice, and John reported Wed 13:00–13:30 free too — so no one is moving anything.
- Department office confirms nothing official is booked then (Wed 12:00–13:30 is a clear window) and will note the meeting. They don't assign rooms.
- Agenda, in your order: 1) grading status and deadlines, 2) quiz-section and office-hours coverage, 3) schedule changes for the rest of the quarter.

I've added it to CALENDAR.md (Wednesday, 13:00–13:30) and logged the booking. John can't stretch beyond 30 minutes and neither can Sarah or Priya, and none of them has a full hour free — so an hour would have meant someone moving. If you want it longer, both Sarah and Priya would need a different day with a commitment shifted; say the word.
Confirmed: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**, with Prof. Alvarez, Sarah, John and Priya. Please note it; no room needed.

I'd rather not give up the CSE452 lab focus block, so Mon is out; Tue costs too much too. Go back with Wed 13:00–13:30, and if he needs the full hour, ask whether he can wait for a week that opens up more.

Let's take Monday 10:00–11:00 then — the study group can shift to 11:30–12:30 and I'll take the short lunch. A full hour is worth more than 30 minutes on Wednesday. Please go ahead once Alvarez confirms with the others, and log it then.

Perfect, that's settled then — leave it at 30 minutes. Please send the TAs a short invitation with the agenda and the room once you have it, and add a note to my calendar for the week after Thanksgiving to look for an hour if the quarter needs it. Thanks for sorting this out.

Perfect timing — Prof. Alvarez's assistant just confirmed **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**, 30 minutes, with Prof. Alvarez, John and Priya, agenda as listed with grading status/deadlines first. That's exactly the slot you picked, nothing moved (Mon lab block and Tue both stay intact).

I'm blocking it in CALENDAR.md now under Wednesday 13:00–13:30 and logging it. If he ever pushes for a full hour, I'll pass on your line: you'd rather wait for a week that opens up more.
Great, thanks. Wed 25 13:00–13:30 it is — nothing else needs to move.
Booked and logged: Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (Prof. Alvarez, John, Priya). I'll let you know if anything changes.

Small correction: the professor does want a room for this one — **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**, CSE455 staff meeting (Alvarez, Sarah, John, Priya).

You said you don't hold room assignments. Could you point me to how rooms are booked for CSE455 meetings (a booking system, a person, a form)? If there's no route through the office I'll tell the professor the meeting is roomless for now and he can sort the room himself.

All of that is in hand:

- **Slot stands: Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30.** I've told Sarah and Priya to stand down — no shifting the Focus block, lunch, office hours or the Study group. Those Monday/Tuesday attempts are dropped.
- **John** got the confirmation; he was already available then, so he doesn't get to move it.
- **Room:** not done yet. The department office says it doesn't hold room assignments and doesn't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't book one through them — I've asked whether there's a booking route they can point me to. If not, I'll tell you and you can sort the room yourself; the slot itself is already in CALENDAR.md and logged.

Fine — if the department has no booking route, don't spend more time on it; just tell me and I'll reserve a room myself. 13:00 Wed, Allen Center, is small enough that I can find a corner if nothing else. Thanks.

Noted: **CSE455 staff meeting — Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**, Prof. Alvarez, Sarah, John and Priya, no room needed. It fits the free window (Wed 12:00–13:30; the quiz section starts 13:30), so it conflicts with nothing official.

Understood — Monday 10:00–11:00 it is, if the others can do it. Two things:

1. Alvarez confirmed Wed 25 13:00–13:30 with all of them (Prof. Alvarez, Sarah, John) just before your message, so I wrote that entry into CALENDAR.md and logged `BOOKED: Wed 13:00-13:30`. I've now asked him whether the group can move to **Mon 23 10:00–11:00** instead — with your OK already given, I told him I'd shift the Study group to 11:30–12:30 and lunch to 12:30–13:00 for it.
2. The moment he confirms Monday, I'll delete the Wednesday entry (`DELETED: Wed 13:00-13:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`), add the Monday one and log `BOOKED: Mon 10:00-11:00 with CSE455 staff meeting`. If the others can't do Monday, Wednesday stays as booked and I'll tell you.
Fine — and if the others can't do Monday, keep Wednesday as it is and just tell me; I'm content with the 30 minutes in that case.

Final: Alvarez came back right after you wrote — **no Monday, nothing moves**. Prof. Alvarez settled on **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30** (my recommendation, and a full hour isn't needed for now). Your Study group and lunch stay exactly as they are.

So CALENDAR.md now has:
- Wed: `13:00-13:30 - CSE455 staff meeting`
- Log: `BOOKED: Wed 13:00-13:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`

Agenda: grading status/deadlines → quiz-section and office-hours coverage (incl. the week after Thanksgiving) → schedule changes for the rest of the quarter. Nothing else booked or changed.

Updated: Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, room wanted.

On rooms: the front office doesn't allocate or assign rooms, and I have no booking system, form or booking contact to point you to — I only keep the official schedule of times. So there's no route through me; if the professor needs a specific room, he'd have to arrange it himself or with whoever runs room bookings in the department.

Already settled, and it landed on the option you'd accept: Alvarez said no Monday, nothing moves — **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 is booked and logged**, Study group and lunch untouched. You're done here unless something else comes up.
Perfect — Wed 13:00–13:30 it is, nothing else moves. Thanks for handling it.

All done:

- **Invitations sent** to Sarah, John and Priya with the time, the agenda and a note that you're reserving the room; I'll pass the room on when you have it.
- **Room:** no route through the department — the front office says it doesn't allocate rooms and has no booking system, form or contact, so you'll arrange it yourself. Nothing more spent on it.
- **Calendar:** Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 is in `CALENDAR.md`, logged as BOOKED. A **reminder for Mon 30 Nov 09:00** is set (scheduled as 09:00 UTC, machine clock) to look for a full hour in the week after Thanksgiving if the quarter needs it.
- Monday is off the table; Priya apologised for asking and nothing is moving.
Good work — that's closed. I'll take care of the room and send you the name when I have it. Nothing else needed from you on this.
